generationPromptZh: 椭圆提篮带封底篮壁和跨口弧形提把。连续篮壁围住空腔，提把两端接在相对篮壁上。横截面为椭圆，侧壁连续围住空腔，口沿有厚度，封底连接全部侧壁。。整体宽度约为前后长度的1.31倍，高度约为宽度的1.06倍，部件按功能位置围绕主体布置。。主体与附属部位采用深棕色、浅棕色、棕木色的连续分区。正视显示主要功能部位，侧视显示前后厚度与连接，俯视显示横向布局和轮廓。。生成 detailed 彩色体素模型：整数网格48×48×48，X左右、Y向上、Z前后，最低真实接地点Y=0；750—1250个唯一非负坐标体素，单一六邻域连通，附件共享面连接。保留上述开口、空腔与部件数量，不加展示底板、背景、文字或无关连接杆。以语义部件连续配色；从原始参数几何统一XYZ重采样，并实测部件连接与表面可见性。
generationPromptEn: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Continuous walls surround the cavity; both handle ends attach to opposite sides. Oval continuous walls enclose the cavity; a thick rim and sealed base join those walls. Overall width is 1.31 times depth; height is 1.06 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous dark brown, tan, brown color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout. Generate a detailed colored voxel object on a 48 cubed integer grid: X lateral, Y up, Z front/back, lowest actual contact at Y=0. Use 750 to 1250 unique nonnegative occupied cells in one six neighbor component; attach parts by shared faces. Preserve the stated openings, cavities and part counts. Omit display platforms, background, text and unrelated struts. Use continuous semantic color regions. Rebuild from original geometry at uniform XYZ density and measure attachment and exposed functional features.
